propositions: The scheduled Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails every run since 2026-08-15T02:39Z due to ACLI aborting on invalid JQL query 'project = LEG AND status != Done' when LEG project does not exist in live Jira.

The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was corrupted with rehearsal fixture keys (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO) via ad-hoc git commits instead of the canonical single-project state {legacy_default: REB, projects: {}}.

The multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot iterates all keys from read_projects() and issues one jql_active query per key; the first nonexistent key LEG causes ACLI exit 1 and reconcile_once raises, failing the entire pass.
The .bridge_state/projects.json write path lacks shared write lock, auto-commit, and auto-publish, enabling uncontrolled ad-hoc hand-commits that corrupted live state.

Restoration of projects.json to canonical state and addition of preflight project visibility verification prevents recurrence and allows live bridge preview and scheduled runs to complete successfully.
